input.command:
cat > /root/entrainment_gated_ft/results/exp005_zoo_expansion/run_pure_v3.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail
source /etc/network_turbo
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1
export HF_XET_HIGH_PERFORMANCE=0
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

MODELS="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/models"
RESULTS="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/results/exp005_zoo_expansion"
LOG="$RESULTS/pure_v3.log"

echo "=== PURE V3 START $(date) ===" | tee "$LOG"

# ---- VERIFY GLA ----
if [ -f "$MODELS/340M-20B-GLA-pure-baseline/model.safetensors" ]; then
  SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$MODELS/340M-20B-GLA-pure-baseline/model.safetensors")
  echo "GLA pure: already exists ($SIZE bytes)" | tee -a "$LOG"
else
  echo "ERROR: GLA pure missing!" | tee -a "$LOG"
  exit 1
fi

# ---- DOWNLOAD DeltaNet + HGRN via Python (Xet disabled) ----
for ARCH_INFO in "DeltaNet:m-a-p/340M-20B-DeltaNet-pure:340M-20B-DeltaNet-pure" "HGRN:m-a-p/340M-20B-HGRN-pure-baseline:340M-20B-HGRN-pure-baseline"; do
  IFS=':' read -r ARCH REPO LOCAL_NAME <<< "$ARCH_INFO"
  LOCAL="$MODELS/$LOCAL_NAME"

  if [ -f "$LOCAL/model.safetensors" ]; then
    SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$LOCAL/model.safetensors")
    if [ "$SIZE" -gt 100000000 ]; then
      echo "$ARCH pure: already exists ($SIZE bytes), skip" | tee -a "$LOG"
      continue
    fi
  fi

  echo "DOWNLOAD $ARCH ($REPO) via Python START $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
  python3 -c "
import os
os.environ['HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET'] = '1'
os.environ['HF_XET_HIGH_PERFORMANCE'] = '0'
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
snapshot_download(
    '$REPO',
    local_dir='$LOCAL',
    force_download=True,
)
print('Download OK: $REPO')
" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"
  echo "DOWNLOAD $ARCH DONE $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
done

# ---- VERIFY ----
echo "=== VERIFY ===" | tee -a "$LOG"
ALL_OK=true
declare -A DIRS
DIRS[GLA]="$MODELS/340M-20B-GLA-pure-baseline"
DIRS[DeltaNet]="$MODELS/340M-20B-DeltaNet-pure"
DIRS[HGRN]="$MODELS/340M-20B-HGRN-pure-baseline"

for ARCH in GLA DeltaNet HGRN; do
  LOCAL="${DIRS[$ARCH]}"
  if [ -f "$LOCAL/model.safetensors" ]; then
    SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$LOCAL/model.safetensors")
    echo "$ARCH pure: OK ($SIZE bytes)" | tee -a "$LOG"
  else
    echo "$ARCH pure: MISSING" | tee -a "$LOG"
    ALL_OK=false
  fi
done

if [ "$ALL_OK" = false ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Some downloads failed" | tee -a "$LOG"
  exit 1
fi

# ---- EVALUATE ALL 3 ----
echo "=== EVAL START $(date) ===" | tee -a "$LOG"
for ARCH in GLA DeltaNet HGRN; do
  LOCAL="${DIRS[$ARCH]}"
  OUTDIR="$RESULTS/${ARCH}_pure"
  echo "EVAL $ARCH pure START $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
  python -m lm_eval \
    --model hf \
    --model_args pretrained=$LOCAL,trust_remote_code=True \
    --tasks lambada_openai,arc_easy \
    --device cuda:0 \
    --batch_size auto \
    --log_samples \
    --output_path "$OUTDIR/" 2>&1 | tail -20 | tee -a "$LOG"
  echo "EVAL $ARCH pure DONE $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
done

echo "=== ALL DONE $(date) ===" | tee -a "$LOG"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/entrainment_gated_ft/results/exp005_zoo_expansion/run_pure_v3.sh
echo "Script written"

#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail
source /etc/network_turbo
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

MODELS="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/models"
RESULTS="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/results/exp005_zoo_expansion"
LOG="$RESULTS/pure_v4.log"
FILES="config.json generation_config.json tokenizer.json tokenizer_config.json special_tokens_map.json model.safetensors"

echo "=== PURE V4 START $(date) ===" | tee "$LOG"

# Download function using wget with non-Xet URL
download_model() {
  local REPO_NAME="$1"
  local LOCAL="$2"
  local ARCH="$3"
  
  if [ -f "$LOCAL/model.safetensors" ]; then
    SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$LOCAL/model.safetensors")
    if [ "$SIZE" -gt 100000000 ]; then
      echo "$ARCH: exists ($SIZE bytes), skip" | tee -a "$LOG"
      return 0
    fi
  fi
  
  mkdir -p "$LOCAL"
  rm -f "$LOCAL/.cache" -rf
  
  echo "DOWNLOAD $ARCH START $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
  for f in $FILES; do
    if [ -f "$LOCAL/$f" ] && [ "$f" != "model.safetensors" ]; then
      echo "  $f exists, skip" | tee -a "$LOG"
      continue
    fi
    echo "  Downloading $f..." | tee -a "$LOG"
    wget --timeout=600 --tries=3 --continue \
      "https://huggingface.co/m-a-p/${REPO_NAME}/resolve/main/${f}?not-for-hierarchical-xet=true" \
      -O "$LOCAL/$f" 2>&1 | grep -E '(saved|error|ERROR|failed|100%)' | tee -a "$LOG"
    echo "  $f done" | tee -a "$LOG"
  done
  
  if [ -f "$LOCAL/model.safetensors" ]; then
    SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$LOCAL/model.safetensors")
    echo "DOWNLOAD $ARCH DONE: $SIZE bytes $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
  else
    echo "DOWNLOAD $ARCH FAILED $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
    return 1
  fi
}

# GLA already done
echo "GLA: checking..." | tee -a "$LOG"
if [ -f "$MODELS/340M-20B-GLA-pure-baseline/model.safetensors" ]; then
  SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$MODELS/340M-20B-GLA-pure-baseline/model.safetensors")
  echo "GLA: OK ($SIZE bytes)" | tee -a "$LOG"
fi

# Download DeltaNet and HGRN
download_model "340M-20B-DeltaNet-pure" "$MODELS/340M-20B-DeltaNet-pure" "DeltaNet"
download_model "340M-20B-HGRN-pure-baseline" "$MODELS/340M-20B-HGRN-pure-baseline" "HGRN"

# ---- EVALUATE ALL 3 ----
echo "=== EVAL START $(date) ===" | tee -a "$LOG"

declare -A DIRS
DIRS[GLA]="$MODELS/340M-20B-GLA-pure-baseline"
DIRS[DeltaNet]="$MODELS/340M-20B-DeltaNet-pure"
DIRS[HGRN]="$MODELS/340M-20B-HGRN-pure-baseline"

for ARCH in GLA DeltaNet HGRN; do
  LOCAL="${DIRS[$ARCH]}"
  OUTDIR="$RESULTS/${ARCH}_pure"
  if [ ! -f "$LOCAL/model.safetensors" ]; then
    echo "SKIP EVAL $ARCH: model missing" | tee -a "$LOG"
    continue
  fi
  echo "EVAL $ARCH pure START $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
  python -m lm_eval \
    --model hf \
    --model_args pretrained=$LOCAL,trust_remote_code=True \
    --tasks lambada_openai,arc_easy \
    --device cuda:0 \
    --batch_size auto \
    --log_samples \
    --output_path "$OUTDIR/" 2>&1 | tail -20 | tee -a "$LOG"
  echo "EVAL $ARCH pure DONE $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
done

echo "=== ALL DONE $(date) ===" | tee -a "$LOG"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/entrainment_gated_ft/results/exp005_zoo_expansion/run_pure_v4.sh
echo "OK"
